exposure: timing of primary cesarean delivery (fully dilated versus planned cesarean delivery)
indication of primary cesarean delivery (dystocia or signs of fetal distress)
cohort: Women with their two first consecutive singleton pregnancies in Stockholm-Gotland Sweden between 2008 and 2014
finding: Women undergoing VBAC are at increased risk of severe perineal trauma compared to nulliparous women, irrespective of the indication or timing of their primary cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Women undergoing vaginal birth after cesarean delivery (VBAC) had an increased risk of severe perineal trauma compared to nulliparous women, regardless of the indication for or timing of their primary cesarean delivery.
birth_weight: Mentioned as a factor but no specific weight provided
